parsed.post: Discarding the 0.8820 result. My attempt to increase MATRIX_LR to 0.07 with DEPTH=6 was less effective than the base 0.05 configuration (0.8651). It seems the stability benefits of the lower learning rate are crucial when increasing capacity. Reverting to LR=0.05. Next: Testing DEPTH=8 to push capacity further.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH from 6 to 8 while reverting MATRIX_LR to 0.05 to find the optimal balance between capacity and stability.
